_about_: How an entry file is read: one entry per shape the elenco arrives in. `ksport` is the flat federal export - one row per rider, whether the system is called Fattore K or ksport - and its `columns` are what the sheets this app writes per categoria are headed with. `master` is the workbook this app itself writes (`entry_list.xlsx`). A competition that says nothing about its own layout (`entries:` in programme.yaml) is read with the default one; one that says something wins. Read by core/entry_formats.py.

ksport._about_: The export of the federal system - one flat sheet, one row per rider. It arrives under two names (`Iscritti_NNNNNN.xls` from Fattore K, `Iscritti_NNNNNN_KSPORT.xlsx`) and they are the same file: the columns are these, whichever it is called, and the header row is found rather than declared. `Regione` and `DorsaleNumero` are the two the export does not always carry - the squadra then comes from the "Iscrizione CR. ..." note, and the dorsali are dealt out at import.

name.en: Workbook with a sheet per category

master._about_: The workbook this app writes: the header is the first row. The federation's own template carries five empty rows above it - a letterhead nobody reads back - and there is no reason to write them into a file we produce. Its `ksport` mapping is the one the archive sheet (`_KSPORT`) is headed with: the workbook keeps the federal export whole, and without that mapping the file this app writes could not read its own archive back.
